# Real-data interface

The real-data layer accepts arbitrary numeric predictors, ordinal proxies, and
an optional sparse calibration matrix. It exposes no data download or hidden
path behavior. The developing application has a standalone R Markdown file
under `applications/` and will remain separate from the simulation studies.

```{r copy-real-data-interface, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "R-scripts", "real-data.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```
